title: GTA 6 Reveals Must-Have New Hardware Ahead Of Launch
excerpt: Grand Theft Auto 6 players can check out this official new PlayStation hardware revealed at today's State of Play event.
content:
Grand Theft Auto 6 fans will want to keep an eye out for a newly announced set of GTA 6 DualSense controllers announced today at the PlayStation State of Play event.

You may have missed the new controller reveal, but PlayStation teased them just ahead of the Final Fantasy Revelation trailer, and they're absolutely stunning.

More to come.
